title: Residentiele ontwikkelingen in uitdijende stedelijke gebieden, 1960-1980, 1983
authors: Laan, L. van der, Erasmus Universiteit Rotterdam * Rotterdam, Economisch geografisch instituut (primary investigator)
contributors: Faculteit geografie en planologie, VU * Amsterdam (research initiator)
descriptions: What are the effects of expanding urban residential systems on the constituting parts of these systems, both in a qualitative and in a quantitative way. The migration areas of both Randstad wings, North ( P0870a ) and South ( P0870b ), are compared with each other. Attention is focused on spatial wave models as the context for a description of the effects of migration.
